prompt.en: A 7 MHz signal enters a receiver stage and leaves at the same frequency with the same modulation, but at a larger voltage. What did the stage do?

text.en: Amplified the RF signal without changing it to audio
Protected the battery from reverse polarity

explanation.en: Amplification raises signal level while preserving the wanted waveform; a 7 MHz signal is still RF when it leaves at 7 MHz.

prompt.en: An audio amplifier is overdriven until the voice waveform has flattened peaks. What problem is most likely?

text.en: Less occupied bandwidth because all peaks are flattened

explanation.en: Clipping is non-linear operation: it changes the waveform shape and produces distortion products.

prompt.en: A power supply uses four diodes before a filter capacitor so both halves of the AC waveform feed the same DC polarity. Which diode job is this?

text.en: Voltage regulation by a Zener diode
Reverse-polarity protection at a DC input

explanation.en: A rectifier uses diode one-way action to turn alternating current into current of one polarity before filtering.
